Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    Parent.Width < 600,
    "Search",
    "Search by ID, serial number, name or manufacturer"
)

"Filters" &
 With(
     { n:
         If(IsBlank(drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value = "All campuses", 0, 1) +
         If(IsBlank(drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value = "All rooms", 0, 1) +
         If(IsBlank(drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value = "All research groups", 0, 1) +
         If(IsBlank(drpFilterStatus.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterStatus.Selected.Value = "All statuses", 0, 1)
     },
     If(n = 0, "", " (" & n & ")")
 )

If(
    varHomeTab = "assets",
    CountRows(galAssets.AllItems) & " asset(s)",
    CountRows(galSetups.AllItems) & " setup(s)"
) & "   -   build " & varBuildId

With(
    { q: Trim(txtSearch.Text) },
    Filter(
        Filter(
            Equipment_Setups,
            IsBlank(drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value = "All campuses"
                || CurrentCampus.Value = drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value,
            IsBlank(drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value = "All rooms"
                || CurrentLocation.Value = drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value
        ),
        IsBlank(q)
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(SetupName, ""))))
    )
)

Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentCampus.Value, "?") & " / " & Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentLocation.Value, "?") &
 "   |   " & CountRows(Filter(Equipment_Assets, ThisItem.Titel in Setups.Value)) & " asset(s)" &
 "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.Status.Value, "")

With(
    { q: Trim(txtSearch.Text) },
    Filter(
        Filter(
            Equipment_Assets,
            IsBlank(drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value = "All campuses"
                || CurrentCampus.Value = drpFilterCampus.Selected.Value,
            IsBlank(drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value = "All rooms"
                || 'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value = drpFilterLocation.Selected.Value,
            IsBlank(drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value = "All research groups"
                || OwnerGroup.Value = drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value
                || UserGroup.Value = drpFilterOwner.Selected.Value,
            IsBlank(drpFilterStatus.Selected.Value)
                || drpFilterStatus.Selected.Value = "All statuses"
                || Status.Value = drpFilterStatus.Selected.Value
        ),
        IsBlank(q)
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(DeviceName, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(Manufacturer, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(SerialNumber, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(q), Lower(Coalesce(UANumber, ""))))
    )
)

Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentCampus.Value, "?") & " / " & Coalesce(ThisItem.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value, "?") &
 "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.OwnerGroup.Value, "-") &
 If(
     IsEmpty(ThisItem.Setups),
     "",
     "   |   setup " & Concat(ThisItem.Setups, Value, ", ")
 )
